JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
JOIN member m ON ex.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
  AND m.position = 'Treasurer';

SELECT T1.event_name 
FROM event AS T1 
INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T2.link_to_event = T1.event_id 
WHERE T2.amount = (SELECT MIN(amount) FROM budget)

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN exp.cost ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
    SUM(exp.cost)) AS percentage
FROM expense exp
JOIN event e ON exp.link_to_event = e.event_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.link_to_event), T3.major_name
FROM attendance AS T1
INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id
INNER JOIN major AS T3 ON T2.link_to_major = T3.major_id
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Luisa' AND T2.last_name = 'Guidi';

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE m.first_name = 'Maya'
      AND m.last_name = 'Mclean'
      AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
) AS attended;

SELECT cost 
FROM expense 
WHERE expense_description LIKE '%September Speaker%' 
  AND expense_description LIKE '%posters%';

SELECT 
    expense.expense_description,
    SUM(expense.cost) AS total_value
FROM expense
INNER JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id
WHERE expense.approved = 'Yes'
  AND budget.category = 'October Meeting'
GROUP BY expense.expense_description
ORDER BY expense.expense_description;

SELECT T1.event_name 
FROM event AS T1 
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event 
INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id 
WHERE T3.position = 'vice president' 
  AND T1.type = 'social' 
  AND T1.location = '900 E. Washington St.'

SELECT DISTINCT member.last_name  
FROM member  
INNER JOIN attendance ON member.member_id = attendance.link_to_member  
INNER JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id  
WHERE event.type = "women's soccer";

SELECT e.event_name, e.event_date  
FROM event e  
INNER JOIN expense ex ON e.event_id = ex.link_to_event  
WHERE ex.expense_description LIKE '%pizza%'  
  AND ex.cost > 50  
  AND ex.cost < 100;

SELECT 
    z.city, 
    z.county 
FROM 
    event e
JOIN 
    attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN 
    income i ON a.link_to_member = i.link_to_member
JOIN 
    zip_code z ON e.location = z.zip_code
GROUP BY 
    e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.income_id) > 40;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY e.link_to_member
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev.event_id) > 1
ORDER BY total_paid DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    (SUM(T1.Extra_Runs) * 100.0) / (SUM(T1.Extra_Runs) + SUM(T2.Runs_Scored)) 
FROM 
    Extra_Runs AS T1 
    INNER JOIN Batsman_Scored AS T2 
        ON T1.Match_Id = T2.Match_Id 
        AND T1.Over_Id = T2.Over_Id 
        AND T1.Ball_Id = T2.Ball_Id 
        AND T1.Innings_No = T2.Innings_No;

SELECT T1.First, T1.Last
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(PurchasePrice) AS total_spent
    FROM transaction
    GROUP BY CustomerID
) AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
ORDER BY T2.total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.first_name || ' ' || T1.last_name AS full_name, T2.amount 
FROM member AS T1 
INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member 
WHERE T2.date_received = '9/9/2019'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.Description FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T1.Date LIKE '2013-09%'
